observations.help: If > 0, system simulation tick is parallelized.
If > 0, sim cache tick is parallelized.
0 spawns tasks for all batches; 1 spawns tasks for all but the final batch; 2 runs all instances inline with the main simulation task.
Non-zero allows GPU ticks to be submitted to the render thread in batches.

decisions.already_parallel_or_pooled: reject no-op enablement ideas for Niagara async simulation, sim-cache async, GPU tick batching, component pools, object pools, dynamic instancing, and parallel pass setup
decisions.TickBatchMode: screen an unpromoted one-factor value 0 candidate because it schedules the final batch as a task; reject if task overhead, frame tails, crashes, or effect correctness regress
